a0_open.description: Open a function: a handle line, then the function (callee signatures with scope "deps"). Send a0_apply the handle line, then replacement node lines.

params.file: .a0/.a0d file in the server root (default: launched file)
params.dense: dense syntax; replies under this handle are dense too
params.lean: dense only: omit the handle line (a reply without one edits the open function)

a0_program.description: Program handle: all signatures, or those around target. Accepts fn ... end blocks that add or replace functions.

params.file: .a0/.a0d file in the server root (default: launched file)
params.dense: dense syntax; replies are dense too

a0_apply.description: Apply an edit (first line: an open handle). Returns the new view or a JSON diagnostic: code (class), id (A0nnnn, see a0 explain), message, expected/actual, fix, applicability (exact or maybe); a failed edit changes nothing. `fix all` applies every exact fix of the last rejection, atomically. Spec lines: `+ex ARGS -> R`, `+pre OP ARGS`, `+post OP ARGS`, `-` removes (program handle: `f:+ex ...`).

params.file: .a0/.a0d file in the server root (default: launched file)

a0_check.description: One line per function with its revision.

params.file: .a0/.a0d file in the server root (default: launched file)

a0_run.description: Run a function on JSON args (u32 numbers, booleans, arrays for arr/struct) in the fuel-bounded interpreter.

params.file: .a0/.a0d file in the server root (default: launched file)
.a0/.a0d file in the server root (default: launched file)

a0_save.description: Write the edited program to its file (or path in the root). Only after a successful a0_apply.

params.file: .a0/.a0d file in the server root (default: launched file)
